subject: E-Commerce
title: Exit Intent Pop-Ups
description: A micro-lesson that makes Exit Intent Pop-Ups usable.

hook.text: Move your mouse toward the browser's close button and a pop-up appears: '10% off if you stay!' It's tracking you.

buildup.text: Exit-intent technology detects cursor movement toward the address bar or tab close button on desktop.

discovery.text: Exit pop-ups recover 10-15% of leaving visitors. A last-second offer converts people who were about to leave.

twist.text: On mobile, there's no cursor. Mobile sites use scroll-up speed or back-button taps to detect exit intent.

climax.text: Exit pop-ups are annoying but profitable. The tension between UX quality and revenue drives endless debate.

punchline.text: Your cursor tells on you. Moving to leave triggers a last-ditch rescue offer.

quiz.question: How do exit-intent pop-ups know you're leaving?
options: They detect cursor movement toward the browser close or address bar
